values.deposit_terms: set by each seller in their own advert; the site states none. One Staffy advert card, shown on both the sale hub and the London hub, asks a £300 deposit, refundable, to hold a chosen puppy until it is collected or handed over

key_insight: Petify is an all-pet advert board whose Staffy sale and London hubs are bare search results: four advert cards, two of them for mixed-breed dogs in another town, with no breed text of the site's own and no licence, health-test or review proof. BSUK can beat it on the Liverpool search it ranks for with a real Liverpool page that carries one breeder's visible proof and a direct way to enquire.
